description: A grassroots movement in several EU countries begins sabotaging power infrastructure near new AI data centres, citing ecological and democratic concerns. The decentralized actions reflect deepening public distrust and are difficult to prevent due to local knowledge and small-scale tactics.

A coordinated response emerges among European member states and other middle powers after the recent denial of frontier access, forming a loose coalition to jointly negotiate for AI capability access and align export licensing. The move is driven by shared vulnerability and frustration with external control over critical infrastructure.
